title: Geological sample
description: A rock, mineral, sediment or fossil with where it came from, what allowed you to collect it, and what you can tell about it.

title.title: Title
title.description: Give this record a short name, such as what you saw and where.

observedOn.title: Date
observedOn.description: The day you saw or collected it (YYYY-MM-DD). If you're not sure of the day, give a range such as 2026-10-01/2026-10-03.

locality.title: Place
locality.description: Describe the place in words. Keep it general if the exact spot could put a species, site or person at risk.

observer.title: Observer or collector
observer.description: Who saw or collected it. This can be you.

description.title: What you saw or did
description.description: Describe what you observed. Keep what you saw separate from what you think it means.

method.title: How you recorded it
method.description: How you observed, collected or captured it, and anything you did differently from usual.

rightsLicense.title: Licence
rightsLicense.description: Records use CC BY 4.0 unless the package says otherwise. Use the licence URI.

sourceReference.title: Source
sourceReference.description: Where the evidence comes from: your field notebook, a project, an instrument log or a publication.

uncertaintyNote.title: What's uncertain
uncertaintyNote.description: Say what is uncertain, estimated or missing. Write 'none known' if nothing is.

curatorReviewReference.title: Curator review reference
curatorReviewReference.description: A curator fills this in after a review. Entering it yourself doesn't mean a review happened.

citationText.title: Citation
citationText.description: How you'd like others to cite this version.

qualityStatement.title: Quality statement
qualityStatement.description: The checks you made, what's missing and any limits a reader should know.

archivePackageReference.title: Archive package reference
archivePackageReference.description: A link to a preservation package. Having one here doesn't mean an archive accepted it.

locationVisibility.title: Who can see the exact place
locationVisibility.description: Public shows your point. Generalised shows a coarser point, so give a matching accuracy. Restricted keeps the place private and needs a private location record. Not collected means no place was recorded.

decimalLatitude.title: Latitude
decimalLatitude.description: Decimal degrees. Places south of the equator, like Australia, are negative.

decimalLongitude.title: Longitude
decimalLongitude.description: Decimal degrees. Places east of Greenwich, like Australia, are positive.

coordinateUncertaintyM.title: Location accuracy (metres)
coordinateUncertaintyM.description: How far the true spot could be from your point, in metres. Phone GPS is often 5 to 30 m. Don't enter 0.

geodeticDatum.title: Map datum
geodeticDatum.description: Phones and web maps use WGS84. Older paper maps and labels may use GDA94, GDA2020 or AGD66. Choose unknown if you're not sure.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: Two capital letters, for example AU for Australia.

materialEntityId.title: Sample identifier
materialEntityId.description: Your label or catalogue number. Photograph any original label or tag first and keep its number.

geologicMaterialType.title: What is it?
geologicMaterialType.description: Mineral, rock, sediment, soil, fossil and so on.

collectionMethod.title: How you found or collected it
collectionMethod.description: Picked up loose, dug, broken from an outcrop, from a mine dump, bought, inherited and so on.

collectionAuthority.title: What allowed you to collect it?
collectionAuthority.description: Landholder consent, a fossicking licence or miner's right, a permit and so on. Choose unknown if you're not sure. This isn't legal advice; check your state's rules.

landTenure.title: Who owns or manages the land?
landTenure.description: Private land, Crown or public land, a national park and so on. Choose unknown if you're not sure.

permitReference.title: Permit or licence number
permitReference.description: The permit, licence or consent reference, if you have one. Keep personal details out.

heritageCheck.title: Any signs of Aboriginal cultural material nearby?
heritageCheck.description: Stone tools, grinding grooves, engravings, ochre pits or scarred trees. If you think so, don't collect: take a photo, keep the place private and contact the local Aboriginal land council or state heritage body.

meteoriteCheck.title: Could it be a meteorite?
meteoriteCheck.description: Heavy, dark crust, magnetic, no bubbles? Some states own meteorites by law. If you think so, keep the place private and contact your state museum.

legalStatusNote.title: Legal status note
legalStatusNote.description: Anything about the law or ownership that applies, in your own words. This isn't legal advice.

photoScale.title: Scale in your photo
photoScale.description: Put a ruler or scale card beside the specimen. Choose no scale if there isn't one; you can add another photo later.

mineralSpecies.title: Mineral name
mineralSpecies.description: The IMA mineral name, 'cf. quartz' if you're unsure, or 'unidentified'. You can check names on mindat.org, but don't copy Mindat text or photos into your records: its licence is different.

imaStatus.title: IMA status of the name
imaStatus.description: Whether the name is an approved mineral species, a variety or trade name, and so on.

mineralIdentifier.title: Mineral database identifier
mineralIdentifier.description: The Mindat or IMA number for the name, if you know it. Name the database in the source.

identificationBasis.title: How you know what it is
identificationBasis.description: A seller's label, matched photos, your own tests, a specialist, or an instrument such as XRD, XRF or Raman.

lithologyClass.title: Rock type
lithologyClass.description: The closest rock name. Choose igneous, sedimentary or metamorphic rock if you only know the group, or unknown.

lithology.title: Rock description
lithology.description: Describe the rock in your own words, and say whether that's what you saw or what you think it is.

mineralComposition.title: Minerals you can see
mineralComposition.description: Minerals you can see or have measured.

formation.title: Formation or unit
formation.description: The geological formation or mapped unit. Use the name from the Australian Stratigraphic Units Database (asud.ga.gov.au) if you can.

ageEarliest.title: Oldest possible age
ageEarliest.description: The oldest time unit it could belong to. Choose unknown if you're not sure.

ageLatest.title: Youngest possible age
ageLatest.description: The youngest time unit it could belong to. Use the same unit as the oldest if you know it exactly.

ageBasis.title: How you know the age
ageBasis.description: A fossil, a radiometric date, a geological map, a publication or your estimate.

geologicAge.title: Age notes
geologicAge.description: Any other age detail, with where it comes from.

stratigraphicContext.title: Layer or bed
stratigraphicContext.description: The layer, bed, horizon or section it came from.

collectionSite.title: Site notes
collectionSite.description: Notes about the site, kept separate from the public place description.

hardness.title: Hardness (Mohs)
hardness.description: Mohs hardness from 1 (talc) to 10 (diamond). Test on a hidden spot, and say what you scratched it with in the method.

streak.title: Streak
streak.description: The colour of its powder on an unglazed tile. Only test where it's safe and won't spoil the specimen.

cleavage.title: Cleavage
cleavage.description: How it breaks along flat planes, and how well.

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: The colour of a fresh surface.

magnetism.title: Magnetism
magnetism.description: Whether a magnet sticks to it.

reactionToAcid.title: Reaction to dilute acid
reactionToAcid.description: Only if you tested safely with dilute acid on a hidden spot.

fossilTaxon.title: Fossil organism
fossilTaxon.description: For a fossil, the organism's name if you know it, at any level.

fossilPartOfOrganism.title: Part of the organism
fossilPartOfOrganism.description: For a fossil, which part it is, such as a shell, tooth or leaf.

sampleObjectType.title: Kind of object
sampleObjectType.description: The physical form you kept: a hand specimen, a thin section, a core and so on.

parentMaterialEntityId.title: Parent sample
parentMaterialEntityId.description: If this was cut or split from another sample, that sample's identifier.

currentRepository.title: Where it's kept
currentRepository.description: The collection or institution holding it, or 'private collection'. Don't give a home address.

igsn.title: IGSN
igsn.description: An IGSN already registered for this sample. This schema doesn't register IGSNs; leave blank if there isn't one.

assertion.description: A value with provenance. Use it when a field's source, method, unit, uncertainty or visibility matters.

conditional.message: Add the mineral name, 'cf.' with a name, or 'unidentified'.
Choose a rock type, or unknown.
Choose the oldest and youngest possible age, or unknown.
Keep the place private: choose generalised, restricted or not collected.
Don't collect possible cultural material. Record it as photographed, not collected.
Keep a possible meteorite find site private: choose generalised, restricted or not collected.
Add the permit or licence reference.
